steps.text: Speak to Gordon south of the Farming Guild.
Speak to Mary inside the main building west of Gordon.
Use a pot of flour on the southern gate next to the cow pen east of Gordon.
Follow the trail of flour south past the bridge then west to the cave at the Kebos Lowlands mine.
Optional: Mine some clay in the mine and pick up two planks just to the west while you're here.
Go back and speak to Gordon.

sections.title: Making the fake head
notes: Needed: Soft clay, knife, bear fur, needle, thread, red dye, hammer, saw, two planks, six nails of any kind

steps.text: Make a clay head by using a knife on the soft clay.
Make a fur head by using bear fur or grey wolf fur on the head while having a needle and thread.
Make a bloody head by using red dye on the head.
Mount the bloody head in the Mounted Head Space on the wall south of the stairs using two planks and six nails.
Speak to Gordon one more time.
